Mustermann Sanitär

A clear, trustworthy website concept for a plumbing and heating business — built around one goal: getting the phone to ring.

Discuss a similar website

Overview

Mustermann Sanitär is a concept for a master plumbing business offering bathrooms, plumbing and heating. Customers often arrive with a problem and a phone in their hand, so speed and clarity matter more than anything else.

Business goals

  • Show competence and reliability immediately
  • Put the phone number and emergency service within one tap
  • Explain services in plain language
  • Build trust with real photos of the team and the work

Design approach

A navy and warm orange palette signals reliability and action. The phone number is the primary button everywhere, and on mobile a fixed call bar keeps it in reach.

Service cards, trust points and a short review section answer the usual questions before the customer has to ask.

Colour palette

  • #0F2A44
  • #42566B
  • #F4F7FA
  • #E8F2FC
  • #F28C28

Typography

  • Plus Jakarta SansHeadings & body

Mobile — the layout is recomposed for small screens, not just scaled down.

This is a concept project created by Lexora Digital to demonstrate our approach. Names, contact details and texts in square brackets are placeholders.
